description: A product's PRICES ON OTHER SHOPS OVER TIME: one series per shop, one point per day, from Logimu's web offers searches and our weekly re-reads of the confirmed shop pages. USE WHEN the user asks how a product's price moved at other shops (Target, Best Buy, eBay ...), or wants a shop's price trend beside Amazon's. DON'T USE for Amazon's own price history (product), for where it is sold right now (web_offers). RETURNS shops[] (domain, url, confidence, matched_by, first_day, last_day, points[] with day, price, currency, availability, source search | refresh), shop_count, point_count. HONESTY: only shops a web offers search confirmed; give the product the way it was searched (the history is kept per search). COST paid plans: 2 credits when any point comes back; free when we hold none.

asin.description: An Amazon US ASIN we hold.

brand.description: The product's brand (with model or title).

gtin.description: A barcode: UPC-12, EAN-13, GTIN-14 or ISBN-13.

item_id.description: A Walmart item ID we hold.

title.description: The product's name, when there is no identifier.
